title: Containment & Large-Asset Relationships

selection_basis.strict_order: OARC-01 → OARC-02 → OARC-03 → OARC-04 → OARC-05 → OARC-06 → OARC-07
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: GPR-06 and MRCS-19 remain independently selected_not_started.

objective: Prove stable-identity large-asset relationships such as carrier → craft, base → docked mecha, vehicle → cargo and nested container → item through existing Asset/containment owners, with explicit load/dock/board/launch/transfer/remove relationships and no implied ownership transfer, duplication or containment cycles.
acceptance: Prove carrier-to-craft, base-to-docked-mecha, vehicle-to-cargo and nested-container-to-item relationships using stable existing Asset identities.
Loading, docking, boarding, launching, transfer and removal change explicit relationships without cloning Assets or implicitly transferring ownership.
Containment validation fails closed on self-containment, arbitrary cycles, duplicate child relationships and ambiguous parentage.
Large-asset containment uses existing D17/PPIA-03/shared-assets ownership and containment seams rather than an OARC ledger.
Capacity is enforced only where the owning governed capacity model exists; unknown capacity is neither zero nor unlimited.
MERA/MBES reserved topology runtimes remain untouched.
boundaries: OARC-05 proves relationships and handoffs only; it does not create an Asset, ownership, inventory, cargo, docking or containment ledger.
Carrier/craft, base/mecha and vehicle/cargo retain separate stable identities.
Installed component relations are not generalized into ownership transfer.
Scene deployment and launch never clone an Asset.
OARC-06 golden-case workflow proof is not started here.
GPR and MRCS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an OARC-specific owner Continue, fresh-read OARC-05 plus OARC01 through OARC04 contracts, the live D17/PPIA-03/shared-assets containment and ownership contracts, PPIA-04 vehicle carriage/docking/launch semantics, and representative carrier/craft/base/mecha/cargo fixtures, then execute the complete bounded relationship-proof tranche.
